title: Andaman Premium Island Retreat
overview:
The Andaman Premium Island Retreat is a 6-day island holiday package that takes you through Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island. The itinerary balances historical sightseeing, relaxing beach visits, optional water activities, and leisure time.

Begin your journey in Port Blair with a visit to the historic Cellular Jail and its evening Light and Sound Show. Continue to Havelock Island, where Radhanagar Beach and the Elephant Beach excursion introduce you to the islands' beautiful coastal scenery. Your journey then continues to Neil Island for the Natural Bridge and time at Bharatpur Beach and/or Laxmanpur Beach, before returning to Port Blair for departure.

This Andaman luxury tour package is planned to make island travel easier by bringing accommodation, inter-island ferry transfers, and sightseeing arrangements together in one itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair – Cellular Jail and Light and Sound Show
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Veer Savarkar International Airport in Port Blair, where a Safar Trails representative will welcome you and assist with your transfer to the hotel.

After check-in, take some time to relax. Later, visit Cellular Jail, a significant historical landmark associated with India's freedom struggle.

In the evening, attend the Light and Sound Show at Cellular Jail, subject to the scheduled show timings and availability. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Arrival at Veer Savarkar International Airport & transfer to hotel
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in, relaxation, and visit to historic Cellular Jail
itinerary.eveningActivity: Light and Sound Show at Cellular Jail (subject to timings and availability)
itinerary.transfers: Airport arrival transfer & local sightseeing transfers

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island – Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the jetty for your ferry journey to Swaraj Dweep, also known as Havelock Island.

Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and complete the check-in formalities. Later, visit Radhanagar Beach, known for its scenic shoreline, soft sand, and beautiful coastal views.

Spend a relaxing evening by the beach and enjoy the sunset, subject to weather and local conditions. Return to the resort for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, checkout, and jetty transfer for ferry to Havelock Island
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Resort check-in formalities and visit to Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.eveningActivity: Relaxing evening by the beach, sunset views, and dinner at the resort
itinerary.transfers: Ferry transfer to Havelock & local transfers

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Excursion – Beach Leisure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed for an excursion to Elephant Beach, subject to weather, sea conditions, and operational availability.

Enjoy the beach surroundings and explore the available optional water activities. Snorkelling and other activities may be available at an additional cost and depend on local conditions.

After the excursion, return to your resort and spend the remainder of the day at leisure. Relax, enjoy the resort facilities, or take in the peaceful island atmosphere.

Dinner and overnight stay at the resort.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast and excursion to Elephant Beach (subject to weather & sea conditions)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Beach surroundings exploration & optional water activities / snorkelling
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisure time at the resort, relaxing atmosphere, dinner, and overnight stay
itinerary.transfers: Elephant Beach excursion transfers as specified

itinerary.title: Havelock Island to Neil Island – Natural Bridge and Beaches
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the resort and transfer to the jetty for your ferry to Shaheed Dweep, also known as Neil Island.

Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and complete check-in. Later, visit the Natural Bridge, a distinctive natural rock formation along the island's coast. The visit is subject to suitable tides, access, and local conditions.

Continue with leisure time at Bharatpur Beach and/or Laxmanpur Beach, depending on available timings and local conditions.

Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in and visit to Natural Bridge coastal rock formation (subject to tides)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisure time at Bharatpur Beach / Laxmanpur Beach, dinner, and overnight stay
itinerary.transfers: Ferry to Neil Island & local hotel transfers

itinerary.title: Neil Island to Port Blair – Leisure and Shopping
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the jetty for your return ferry to Port Blair.

On arrival, transfer to your hotel and check in. The remainder of the day is at leisure. You may explore local markets, browse for souvenirs, or relax at the hotel after your island journey.

Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay in Port Blair.

itinerary.afternoonActivity: Arrival in Port Blair, hotel check-in, and relaxation
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisure time to explore local markets and souvenirs; dinner at hotel
itinerary.transfers: Return ferry to Port Blair & local transfers

itinerary.title: Departure from Port Blair
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Veer Savarkar International Airport for your onward journey.

Depart with memorable experiences of the Andaman Islands, from historic landmarks and scenic beaches to peaceful island escapes.

Your Andaman Premium Island Retreat concludes with Safar Trails.

faqs.question: How many days are enough for an Andaman island holiday?
faqs.answer: A 5 Nights / 6 Days itinerary offers time to explore Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island. It combines historical sightseeing, beach visits, and inter-island travel in one holiday.

faqs.question: What is covered in the Andaman Premium Island Retreat?
faqs.answer: The itinerary includes Port Blair, Cellular Jail, the Light and Sound Show, Radhanagar Beach, an Elephant Beach excursion, Neil Island's Natural Bridge, and time at Bharatpur Beach and/or Laxmanpur Beach. Accommodation, transfers, ferry arrangements, and meals are provided according to the confirmed package.

faqs.question: Is this Andaman tour package suitable for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes. The itinerary offers beach time, scenic coastal locations, and leisure periods that may appeal to couples. Hotel categories and any special arrangements should be confirmed when requesting a quote.

faqs.question: Is the package suitable for families?
faqs.answer: The itinerary may suit families who enjoy sightseeing and relaxed beach holidays. Families should confirm room arrangements, child rates, ferry suitability, and age or safety requirements for optional activities before booking.

faqs.question: Are flights included in the Andaman package?
faqs.answer: Flights are not listed among the package's stated inclusions. Confirm flight arrangements and costs with Safar Trails before finalising your booking.

faqs.question: Are water sports and snorkelling included?
faqs.answer: Snorkelling and other water activities are optional and may involve additional charges. Availability depends on weather, sea conditions, local rules, and the activity operator.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit the Andaman Islands?
faqs.answer: Travel conditions vary by season. Before booking, check the expected weather, ferry operations, and availability of your preferred activities for your travel dates. Safar Trails can help you plan around your intended travel period.

faqs.question: Can I customise the Andaman Premium Island Retreat?
faqs.answer: You can enquire about your preferred travel dates, accommodation category, and additional requirements. Any changes to the itinerary, services, or package price will depend on availability and confirmation.

faqs.question: How do I book an Andaman tour package with Safar Trails?
faqs.answer: Share your intended travel dates, number of travellers, room requirements, and preferred accommodation category with Safar Trails. Request a detailed quotation and review the inclusions, exclusions, payment conditions, and cancellation policy before confirming.
